scope: Independent actual ARM64 instructions for exact 15 owned native dispatcher destinations and native/generated consumer gates, native argument/result ABI, bounded refusal continuations. No source/test/build changes.

resolved_symbols_and_inlining.tls_note: The descriptor-mediated blr sites load thread-local lease/busy state; they are not evidence of an arbitrary context provider. Native gates load only numeric Main/ID/op/consumed lease fields before admission, not target ID storage.
resolved_symbols_and_inlining.inlining: Reset and resync have no separate native static text symbol; their actual switch bodies are at0x101268230 and0x101268144. Four ID lease gates and seven generated Mesh consumers are also inlined. The exported Mesh update body is unique at0x10132c9bc; other similarly named update callbacks were excluded.
resolved_symbols_and_inlining.private_ABI: LLVM drops unused private formal C/override/remap arguments despite unchanged mangled source names. Actual dispatcher and generated call sites agree: create(x0ID,x1Main,w2remap); hierarchy(x0ID,x1Main,x2Scene,x3Layer,x4hint,w5editable); user-remap(x0ID,x1Main,x2newID); make-local(x0ID,x1Main,w2clearOverride,w3clearAsset); destroy(x0ID,x1Main,x2C,x3reports,w4hierarchy). No reliance on demangled formal argument count.
resolved_symbols_and_inlining.aliases: No same-address text alias in extracted native scopes. Dispatcher inlining and generated inlining are recorded explicitly.

argument_and_output_checks.owned_table: All15 entries resolve to recorded bodies. Counts are 32-bit ldr w4 from args+4; native add exports preserve count and reports for ED calls. Mesh bool args load bytes and use w4/w5 ABI; no bool/int surrogate return adaptation.
argument_and_output_checks.ID_outputs: Create/hierarchy/make-local x0 pointer stored with str x0,[sp,#0x18] at0x101268344; pointer address x2=sp+0x18 to RNA_parameter_set_lookup at0x1012683dc, key id from actual cstring0x104b762a2.
argument_and_output_checks.bool_outputs: Validate/material return w0 stored as byte at0x101268328; resync raw w0 saved x20 then byte at0x1012683c8; false resync w20=0 before same byte store. x2=sp+0x17 to setter. Native cstrings result@0x104c1371a and success@0x104c13712 independently decoded.
argument_and_output_checks.generated_ABI: Generated create/hierarchy/make-local use 64-bit str x0; resync/validators use strb to exact ParameterList slots. Generated wrappers have their original CTX_data_main before borrowed consumer gate; they are not the owned callback path. Complete generic/owned bypass proof belongs to outer review.
argument_and_output_checks.no_second_direct_Main_query: No direct CTX_data_main call in the owned native dispatcher or any reviewed native consumer body. The actual dispatcher branches/calls same native functions without invoking generated wrappers. This is not a transitive no-callback proof.
argument_and_output_checks.zero_add_native_admission: Four dispatcher count loads/calls reach the same exported add bodies and existing ED add functions. Native gate precedes ED admission. The outer producer determines trusted count0 frontiers and lease issuance; no alternate count0 mutation body exists in this dispatcher.

boundaries: No global CFG/heap/interpreter/reentrancy/allocator/BKE/depsgraph proof; no device or paint behavior acceptance.
External native routines, TLS runtime, reports/notifiers, exceptions and generated metadata are not recursively audited.

Ordinary refusal walks prove these local branches, not arbitrary all-program reachability. Exact profile admission/producer lifetime/receipt/drain/Main-callback validation are separate outer-review obligations.
This report is independent compiled evidence for the exact binary; source host tests, package CRC/UI/HUD/Weight checks are separately recorded by root.
